title: Indian Model vs Chinese Model Yield Comparison In Agri Tech
reason: Provides information about technology transfer and model adaptation in agriculture.

tasks.task: Describe the technology transfer process from America to India.

subtasks.text: Observe that the technology in America is present in India, and note that many Indian inputs are involved.
Highlight that India has been using technology for about 30 years.

tasks.task: Explain the financial aspects of adopting American and India models.

subtasks.text: Note that American models could generate up to 2 billion rupees.
Mention that Chinese models could produce up to 4 billion rupees.
Describe the process of transferring Chinese models to local use.
Show the time frame for adapting models, ranging from 12 to 24 weeks.
Highlight that adopting Chinese models takes even less time, up to 48 weeks.

tasks.task: Describe the distribution and value addition of agricultural products.

subtasks.text: Observe the trade of 10 million metric tons of rice, and note who is involved in the trade.
Show how value addition is applied to agricultural products.
Mention that a global agricultural trend is being followed.
